system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The harness prompt is controlled separately
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt built from study/parameter context, history and optional reasoning/notes fields; source not shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Hard-function agents receive **no supplied task context**: only generic `x1...x5` parameter names, numeric bounds, and trial history.
env_context_strategy.note: Package mode treats objective as a black box; optional `context` strings can be supplied. Skill mode lets the agent read the project.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Set `history=None` to show all completed/pruned trials.
context_compaction.note: Default history=5 shows only the last N trials; `history=None` disables trimming.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
the agent only proposes values; optim-agent validates
them against the declared space

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
invalid output falls back to safe
sampling
tool_call_format.note: Agent CLI reply is parsed as a parameter proposal; exact format not shown in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
the agent only proposes values; optim-agent validates
them against the declared space, and invalid output falls back to safe
sampling.
tool_count.note: optim-agent exposes no tools of its own to the model; it shells out to a coding-agent CLI which brings its own tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The pip package treats the objective as a black box.
edit_primitive.note: No edit tool in the harness; skill mode relies on the host coding agent's editing.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Requires one authenticated agent CLI on `PATH`
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned; integration is via CLI subprocess and a skill/plugin manifest.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
optim-agent proposes values, validates them against the declared space, records
outcomes, and falls back to safe sampling when an agent reply is invalid.
loop_primitives.note: Loop is propose -> evaluate objective -> record, repeated for n_trials (independent attempts).

multi_agent_topology.note: An optional AgentPruner adds a second agent role for prune/keep decisions.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Adding a new
agent backend usually means one small function in [`optim_agent/agent.py`](optim_agent/agent.py).

human_in_loop.note: optimize() runs unattended; no approval hooks described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
JSON/SQLite studies retain configurations,
outcomes, states, context, and optional agent rationale.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
with the study JSON keeping
history across sessions.
long_term_memory.note: Study JSON/SQLite persists trial history across runs; the repo also ships an installable skill (SKILL.md, plugins).

self_verification.note: The user-supplied objective is evaluated, but the harness runs no tests/linters/judges of the agent's own output; validation is schema validation of proposed values.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
the sampler warns and
falls back to a random point for that trial; the study keeps going.
retry_policy.note: On invalid/timed-out agent output there is fallback sampling, not retry.

rollback.evidence_quote:
the agent only proposes values; optim-agent validates
them against the declared space
rollback.note: No file changes to revert in package mode.

termination_condition.note: n_trials caps the loop; AgentPruner terminates individual trials early.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
**Small-budget leverage** - useful when evaluations are expensive and classical
surrogates are still data-starved.
cost_controls.note: No token/cost budget or caching described; trial count is the budget.

timeouts.evidence_quote:
**A backend call times out or emits invalid output** — the sampler warns and
falls back to a random point for that trial

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
Requires one authenticated agent CLI on `PATH`:
[claude](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code),
[codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), or
[opencode](https://github.com/sst/opencode).
execution_isolation.note: Agent CLIs are invoked as local subprocesses; objectives run in the host process/thread pool.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
loaded in a
coding-agent session, the agent first *reads the project* to understand each
parameter's role
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host machine; package mode gives the agent no filesystem role at all.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
nested sessions inherit
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; run with `env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or from a clean shell.
network_policy.note: No network restriction described; CLI calls reach model APIs.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
Bounded execution** - the agent only proposes values; optim-agent validates
them against the declared space
permission_model.note: No per-action authorisation; the space validation is a value constraint (see H4).

tracing.evidence_quote:

outcomes, states, context, and optional agent rationale.

replayability.evidence_quote: For reproducibility, seeds should be fixed and complete studies stored.

replayability.note: Quote is a translation of the German limitation line; stored studies allow resume, agent replies are not deterministic.
